notes: Adapter descriptors for the local small-LM research harness.
This file is DATA: every machine-specific value (weights directory, cache, API base URL, key variable) is an environment-variable reference, never a path baked into Python.
revision PENDING-A-PIN is a deliberate placeholder: a real run must replace it with an immutable model commit before any number is quoted.
The offline test suite never loads a model and never opens a socket; it only reads these descriptors.
quantization 'nf4' maps to a bitsandbytes 4-bit load in adapters/hf_local.py; 'none' means full precision.
{} is expanded as ${NAME} (empty when unset) or ${NAME:-default} (default when unset/empty).

adapters.notes: No model, no network, no dependency. Alias map and keyword rules are injected config; it abstains instead of guessing.

adapters.display_name: Harness test double - scripted fixture replay
adapters.notes: Replays canned responses from datasets/fixtures/responses_v0.json. This is NOT a model and its output is NOT an empirical result.

adapters.display_name: ARM B - Qwen3-4B base model (local, gated)
adapters.notes: Untuned local model. Refusal-tested only in this work package: every test asserts the closed gate, never a load.

adapters.display_name: ARM C - Qwen3-4B + QLoRA adapter (local, gated)
adapters.notes: Same backend class as Arm B; only the checkpoint/config differs, so Arm C is not a code fork.
Refusal-tested and request-shaping-tested offline only. A real call needs BOTH the remote_api and network gates open plus a key.
